arxiv-2209-00694.title: Quantum Representation Theory and Manin matrices II: super case
arxiv-2209-00694.creator: Alexey Silantyev
arxiv-2209-00694.description: Abstract We construct super-version of Quantum Representation Theory. The quadratic super-algebras and operations on them are described. We also describe some important monoidal functors. We proved that the monoidal category of graded super-algebras with Manin product is coclosed relative to the subcategory of finitely generated quadratic super-algebras.

arxiv-2302-11423.title: The inverse Cox-Ingersoll-Ross process for parsimonious financial price modeling
arxiv-2302-11423.creator: L. Lin and D. Sornette
arxiv-2302-11423.description: Abstract We construct new classes of financial price processes based on the insight that the key variable driving prices P P is the earning-over-price ratio γ ≃ 1 / P \gamma\simeq 1/P , which we refer to as the earning yield and is analogous to the yield-to-maturity of an equivalent perpetual bond.

arxiv-2308-12741.title: Photocurrents in bulk tellurium
arxiv-2308-12741.creator: M. D. Moldavskaya 1 , L. E. Golub 1 , S. N. Danilov 1 , V. V. Bel’kov 2 , D. Weiss 1 and S. D. Ganichev 1
arxiv-2308-12741.description: Abstract We report a comprehensive study of polarized infrared/terahertz photocurrents in bulk tellurium crystals. We observe different photocurrent contributions and show that, depending on the experimental conditions, they are caused by the trigonal photogalvanic effect, the transverse linear photon drag effect, and the magnetic field induced linear and circular photogalvanic effects.

arxiv-2311-15834.title: Charge-density wave transition in magnetic topological semimetal EuAl 4
arxiv-2311-15834.creator: R. Yang, C. C. Le, P. Zhu, Z. W. Wang, T. Shang, Y. M. Dai, J. P. Hu, M. Dressel
arxiv-2311-15834.description: Abstract The interplay among topology, charge-density wave (CDW), and magnetism can give rise to a plethora of exotic quantum phenomena. Recently, a group of magnetic topological semimetals with tetragonal lattices and CDW order were found to exhibit anomalous magnetic instability, helical spin ordering, and the presence of skyrmions. However, the underlying mechanism responsible for these observations remains unclear.

arxiv-2312-01182.title: Thresholds for patterns in random permutations with a given number of inversions
arxiv-2312-01182.creator: David Bevan, Dan Threlfall
arxiv-2312-01182.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by David Bevan, Dan Threlfall. We explore how the asymptotic structure of a random permutation of [ n ] [n] with m m inversions evolves, as m m increases, establishing thresholds for the appearance and disappearance of any classical, consecutive or vincular pattern. The threshold for the appearance of a classical pattern depends on the greatest number of inversions in any of its sum indecomposable components. † † footnotetext: † Department of Mathematics and Statistics, University of Strathclyde, Glasgow, Scotland.

arxiv-2503-19136.title: Stochastic Poisson Surface Reconstruction with One Solve using Geometric Gaussian Processes
arxiv-2503-19136.creator: Sidhanth Holalkere, David S. Bindel, Silvia Sellán, Alexander Terenin
arxiv-2503-19136.description: Abstract Poisson Surface Reconstruction is a widely-used algorithm for reconstructing a surface from an oriented point cloud. To facilitate applications where only partial surface information is available, or scanning is performed sequentially, a recent line of work proposes to incorporate uncertainty into the reconstructed surface via Gaussian process models.

pmc-12382065.description: ObjectiveThere is limited research on the association between serum albumin to creatinine ratio (sACR) and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD). pmc-13207217.title: Somatostatin in Aging: Correlations with Selected Central Nervous System and Gastrointestinal Tract Diseases
pmc-13207217.creator: Aldona Kasprzak
pmc-13207217.description: The hypothalamic–pituitary–somatotropic (HPS) axis, which includes growth hormone (GH) and insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1), is one of three endocrine systems that show a decline in hormone concentration with age. Among the hypothalamic hormones involved in the aging process, GH-releasing hormone (GHRH) and somatostatin (SST) are most affected, resulting in several age-related changes.

pmc-13553918.creator: Hawra Al-Ghafli, Aymen Alqurain, Faisal M. Alzahrani, Nasreldin Elhadi, Jignesh Prajapati, Haseeb Nisar
pmc-13553918.description: IntroductionLeishmaniasis is a vector-borne parasitic disease caused by protozoa of the genus Leishmania, characterized by clinical outcomes ranging from self-limiting cutaneous lesions to fatal visceral disease. Disease progression is multifactorial and is largely shaped by interactions between the parasite and host macrophages, as well as by other host- and pathogen-related factors.

pmc-13558832.title: Family Care Management of Patients With Chronic Diseases: A Concept Analysis
pmc-13558832.creator: Reza Nematollahi Maleki, Akram Ghahramanian, Mojgan Lotfi, Azad Rahmani, Reza Negarandeh
pmc-13558832.description: BackgroundChronic diseases are major contributors to global morbidity and mortality, and family members often assume primary caregiving roles. This study analysed the concept of family care management of patients with chronic diseases.MethodsWalker and Avant's eight‐step concept analysis method was used.
